summary: Frontend testing of 'Lidi' (People) module completed successfully. All 10 requested features verified and working correctly. Module opens from toolbar, displays people in categories (Tým, Dodavatel, Investor), detail panel shows full info with correct section for each person type (Osobní úkoly for team, Checklist for non-team). Search, filter, and add person functionality all working.

issues: Minor: Investor category starts collapsed by default (user must click to expand), while Tým and Dodavatel are expanded. Consider keeping all categories expanded initially for better UX.

critical_code_review_comments: PeopleModule.jsx is well-structured with proper state management
Default data initialization covers all required person types
Category toggle (expandedCategories) logic works but default has investor in state, yet UI shows collapsed - minor inconsistency
PersonDetailPanel correctly conditionally renders 'Osobní úkoly' for team vs 'Checklist' for others
data-testid attributes properly added to person cards for testing
seed_data_creation: App initializes with 4 default people: Jan Novák (team), Marie Svobodová (team), Eva Králová (supplier), Petr Dvořák (investor)
